newsitem.title: USA: Wallace Computer closes acquisition, wins contract.
newsitem.headline: Wallace Computer closes acquisition, wins contract.

text.p: Wallace Computer Services Inc said Thursday it completed acquisition of privately-held Moran Printing Co, a commercial printer based in Orlando, Fla.. Terms were not disclosed.
Separately, Wallace said it has been awarded a three-year contract to supply Shared Services Healthcare Inc with information management products including forms, forms management and office supplies.
The contract, worth about $5 million annually, went into effect July 1, 1997.

Based in Atlanta, Ga., Shared Services is a large group purchasing organization with over 1,100 member healthcare organizations in the southeast such as hospitals, surgical centers, long-term care facilities and clinics.
